verdict.rationale: Asana markets AI Teammates, AI Studio no-code automations, and 'Asana Dash' as an AI Chief of Staff, and a confirmed official MCP server exists (asana-probe-3) that would let AI agents/LLM clients issue natural-language commands against Asana data. However, all detail is vendor marketing copy with no independent or hands-on verification that natural-language commands reliably operate the product end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on demonstration of natural-language task/workflow operation, detail on scope/limits of AI Teammates and Dash, and confirmation the MCP server supports full read/write command coverage.
